simple.meaning: פְּלִשְׁתִּי (Pᵉlishtîy) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 10:14. The surrounding context includes flock, covenant, kingship, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פְּלִשְׁתִּי (H6430) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
